xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4307: Session Vault: dashboard consumer (automatic settlement, sync loop, Settings → Session Vault)

plan.title: Session Vault: dashboard consumer (auto-settle, sync loop, Settings → Session Vault eviction review)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-2609 shipped the Session Vault as a standalone CLI. In Overdeck mode nothing saves dashboard conversations unless the operator runs pan vault by hand, nothing pulls records on a timer, and the pending-deletion batch can only be reviewed in a terminal. The existing transcript watch runs only while a browser views a conversation, and confirmEviction would delete an entry the panel showed as failed if it now passed.
narratives.Proposal: Add a dashboard vault service (primary dashboard only) that serializes every vault operation through one queue, runs a sync cycle 5 s after boot and every syncIntervalSec with offline backoff, refreshes the eviction batch with an Overdeck-mode isLive check, and exposes a status snapshot and a sync-report hook. A 15 s poller settles active managed conversations 30 s after they go quiet, force-settles (WIP snapshot) on session end and at shutdown within 10 s. Six /api/vault/* routes and a Settings → Session Vault panel show state, machines with last-synced time, and the batch with 'Yes, delete these' (skipFailed), decline, clear and re-offer. Vault resolution moves to src/lib/vault/open.ts. Browse copies (PAN-4436) and Continue here (PAN-4437) are sibling issues whose designs live in the PRD.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Browse copies, origin:'vault' conversation rows, owner badges or read-only composers (PAN-4436)
- Continue here, the drift dialog, dashboard WIP apply, clone-and-register, 'continued on' or 'local turns saved as a fork' states (PAN-4437)
- The first-run 'Continue from another machine' card and any dashboard setup, join or passphrase entry (PAN-4330)
- Automatic settlement of work-agent, planning or specialist transcripts (CLI save --all; PAN-4308 for Fly)
- Any automatic deletion of a transcript, or any change to the CLAUDE.md 'JSONL session files are sacred' rule
- Per-entry selection checkboxes in the batch panel
- Changes to ~/.overdeck/config.yaml or the dashboard settings schema for vault keys
- Cross-process locking between a terminal pan vault command and the dashboard
- Background vault work in peer dashboards

autoDecisions.summary: Split the filed scope three ways: PAN-4307 keeps automatic settlement, the sync loop, eviction liveness, the machine list and Settings → Session Vault; browse copies moved to PAN-4436 and Continue here (with clone-and-register, WIP apply, continued-on states) to PAN-4437.
autoDecisions.rationale: The full scope counts about 50 files over 8 subsystems; pan plan finalize refuses more than 25 files or 6 subsystems and the planning contract prefers independently shippable siblings. The PAN-2609 planner split the same PRD the same way.

autoDecisions.summary: The first-run 'Continue from another machine' card stays with PAN-4330.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4330's own body lists the card and its git-remote half is a secret-carrying join route that belongs with the sign-in client.

autoDecisions.summary: Growth detection uses a dedicated 15 s poller over active managed conversations, not watchConversation.
autoDecisions.rationale: watchConversation runs only while a browser subscribes to a conversation (ws-rpc.ts streamClaudeTranscript), so it cannot trigger background settlement.

autoDecisions.summary: Overdeck-mode liveness uses conversation-liveness.ts for conversations and agents/liveness.ts for agent directories; a probe error counts as live.
autoDecisions.rationale: conversation-liveness.ts is the documented single liveness door for conversations (Herdr and tmux); never delete on uncertainty.

autoDecisions.summary: confirmEviction gains skipFailed; the dashboard always passes it, the CLI never does.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-22 says failed entries cannot be selected and the button deletes exactly the displayed entries; without the option a failed entry that now passes would be deleted.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Yes, delete these' is a single click with no second modal, and there are no per-entry checkboxes.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-22 names the click as the confirmation; the fingerprint 409 prevents deleting anything not displayed; decline already removes single entries.

autoDecisions.summary: Vault resolution moves from the CLI into src/lib/vault/open.ts openVaultContext(); CLI output is unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: The dashboard needs the same key/rotation/keyring checks without CLI I/O, and one resolver avoids drift.

autoDecisions.summary: Background vault work runs only in the primary dashboard; routes run in every dashboard.
autoDecisions.rationale: Two dashboards settling the same transcripts would race; the UAT fixture is a peer dashboard and still needs the routes.

autoDecisions.summary: No dashboard setup, join or passphrase entry; the off state points to pan vault setup.
autoDecisions.rationale: Secret entry over local HTTP belongs with PAN-4330; the PRD's FR-1 dashboard mention is optional.

Rule order: a path under AGENTS_DIR resolves its first segment as agent id and returns (await isAlive(agentId)).alive from src/lib/agents/liveness.ts; a UUID-named .jsonl looks up getConversationByClaudeSessionId and returns conversationHarnessAlive(row.tmuxSession) from src/lib/overdeck/conversation-liveness.ts; anything else returns false; any thrown error returns true. All four collaborators and agentsDir are injectable for tests.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-4 exactly: module singletons like services/conversation-rescan-scheduler.ts exporting startVaultService, stopVaultService, enqueueVaultOperation (one-at-a-time promise queue), getVaultServiceSnapshot (VaultStatusResponse shape from the PRD wire contract), onVaultSyncReport, reviewEvictionBatch, confirmEvictionBatch (skipFailed:true plus isLive from createVaultIsLive), declineEvictionEntry, clearEvictionBatch, reofferEvictionEntry. Each cycle calls openVaultContext and readVaultConfig afresh; a vault that is not open is a silent no-op recorded in the snapshot. The first cycle runs VAULT_BOOT_DELAY_MS (5000) after start, then createSyncLoop with the configured interval, recreated when syncIntervalSec changes (stop the old loop first). afterSettle runs scanEligible with isLive when evict is true, then each listener with errors caught. Wire start and stop into main.ts inside the existing !isPeerDashboard block after startPullRequestSyncService and after stopConversationRescanScheduler in handleShutdownSignal.

Add vault-settle-poller.ts: debounced, session-end and shutdown settles

expected_outputs: vault-settle-poller.test.ts and vault-service.test.ts pass under fake timers

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-5 exactly. createVaultSettlePoller(deps) returns start, stop and flush(budgetMs). Every VAULT_POLL_MS (15000) it lists active claude-code and codex managed conversations, resolves each transcript path once through resolveSessionFile (cache non-null results), stats it, and on a size change re-arms a debounceSec timer that settles with wip 'auto' through the vault-service queue. A tracked conversation that leaves the active list gets one settle with wip 'force' and is forgotten. flush cancels timers and force-settles every tracked path within the budget, logging how many were skipped when it expires. vault-service creates the poller in startVaultService and calls flush(10000) then stop in stopVaultService.

items.title: Given a transcript that grows and then stays the same size for debounceSec, the poller calls settle exactly once with wip 'auto'
Given a transcript that keeps growing on every poll, no settle runs until it stays quiet for debounceSec
Given a tracked conversation whose status changes from active to ended, the poller calls settle once with wip 'force'
Given a settle that never resolves, flush(10000) returns after the budget and logs the skipped count
Given a conversation with a resolved path across ten polls, resolvePath is called once, and the mocked transcript-deletion-door spy records zero calls with evict:true
Add six /api/vault/* routes with no-loss-matrix rows

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-6 and the wire contract. Create src/dashboard/server/routes/vault.ts in the style of routes/model-presets.ts with GET /api/vault/status, GET /api/vault/eviction-batch, POST /api/vault/eviction-batch/confirm, POST /api/vault/eviction-batch/decline, POST /api/vault/eviction-batch/clear, POST /api/vault/eviction-batch/reoffer. GETs call rejectUnauthorizedDashboardRequest; POSTs call rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest. Each route calls only vault-service functions, never evict.ts or the deletion door. Register vaultRouteLayer in server.ts makeRoutesLayer beside modelPresetsRouteLayer and add six NO_LOSS_MATRIX rows after the model-presets rows.
